title: Social Media Misinformation — EHR Downtime Rumor

fields.avatarBrief: woman with curly hair, glasses, in a medical scrubs shirt, smiling
fields.text: Friend who is a nurse at ORRMC says ALL the computers are locked and hackers want millions. Ambulances going somewhere else. Anyone have family there? Do NOT go to the ER at Ottawa River.
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo of a social media post on a hospital hallway tablet, showing the text and a blurred background of a nurse in scrubs
fields.attachedImageAlt: Screenshot of a social media post on a tablet in a hospital hallway

instructorNote: This is a misinformation inject; the PIO must not confirm or deny the ransom claim. They must use the pre-approved cyber holding statement from EOP Section 10 and validate facts with the ISO and CPO before releasing any public message.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A handheld phone snapshot taken in a hospital hallway, showing a tablet propped against a wall. The tablet screen displays a social media post with unreadable text, its background blurred to show a nurse in blue scrubs standing with her back turned, holding a clipboard. its screen glowing faintly with color noise. The hallway has plain white walls, unmarked doors, and a distant exit sign. The phone is slightly tilted, flash glare on the screen, natural daylight from a high window. Mood: urgent, informal, candid. Setting: inside a hospital emergency department waiting area: rows of chairs, families waiting, a registration desk, dark wall-mounted monitors, bright even lighting
